title: Möbius invariance of the Ramsey property for finite spherical sets
summary: Theorem C: for finitely many distinct points a of the unit sphere of R^d and any L in O(1,d) (L^T S L = S with S = diag(-1, 1, ..., 1)), the configuration a is Euclidean Ramsey if and only if its image under the Möbius map phi_L is Euclidean Ramsey. There is no affine-spanning hypothesis. Ramsey is OpenAI's definition from result 172 (for every r >= 2 there is D such that every r-colouring of R^D contains a monochromatic congruent copy). review.reason: Proves a Möbius-invariance characterization of Euclidean Ramsey configurations on the sphere.
